questions.prompt: According to WHO's World Malaria Report 2025, how many people worldwide died of malaria in 2024 (estimate)?
questions.insight: About 95% of malaria deaths in 2024 occurred in the WHO African Region.

questions.prompt: Around 1820, by historians' estimates, what share of the world's adults (aged 15 and over) could read and write?
questions.insight: Two centuries ago only about one in ten adults could read; today the global figure is roughly 87 percent.

questions.prompt: According to the US National Human Genome Research Institute's tracking of sequencing costs, roughly how many US dollars did it cost to sequence one human genome in 2022?
questions.insight: In 2001 the same tracking put the cost near $95 million per genome, roughly 180,000 times more than in 2022.

questions.prompt: Of all the fresh water on Earth, what percentage is locked up in ice caps, glaciers and permanent snow?
questions.insight: Oceans hold about 96.5 percent of all Earth's water, so fresh water is a small slice, and most of it is frozen.

questions.prompt: According to the UNICEF/WHO/World Bank Joint Child Malnutrition Estimates, what share of children under 5 worldwide were stunted (too short for their age) in 2024?
questions.insight: That is about 150 million children under 5 who were stunted.
